body:
Hi Dr. Bhriain,

I'm Anirudh Bagla, a student at Harvard Business School. I saw on your site that you published a patient guide to managing GLP-1 side effects and wanted to reach out. Since Charles River Endocrinology already supports GLP-1 patients, your view of what happens between visits would be especially useful. Given your focus on obesity medicine and GLP-1 therapy, I'd value your perspective.

My co-founder and I are exploring shared nutritionist and coach support for GLP-1 patients at independent practices like Charles River Endocrinology, with the insurance billing handled. We want to know if it would work for you.

We're not selling anything. Would you have 30 minutes on Thu 10/22 2:00pm or Mon 10/26 10:00am, by phone or in person at your practice?

Thank you,
Anirudh Bagla · +1••••••0199

Reply "stop" and we won't contact you again.
